name: What additional costs should I budget for when buying a waterfront home?

mainEntity.name: What additional costs should I budget for when buying a waterfront home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond the purchase price, waterfront homes often incur additional costs. These can include higher insurance premiums for flood and wind, maintenance for seawalls, docks, or other marine structures, and potentially HOA fees in gated waterfront communities. When preparing your budget, consider these ongoing expenses, especially for properties in coastal areas like Fort Lauderdale Beach or Sunny Isles Beach, to ensure a complete financial picture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Budget for higher insurance (flood/wind), maintenance for marine structures (seawalls, docks), and potential HOA fees.
